claims.claim: Air Pump-requires minimum effort and within a few strokes air gets inflated
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an electric handheld soldering/heat tool with a hot-tip style metal front and a power cord; no air pump or inflation mechanism is shown.
No weight/scale or clear comparison shot is provided in the witness report.
No brand label, import markings, receipt, or packaging details are shown/read in the witness report.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include any test results (heating to temperature, switch operation, stable operation) or internal/opening evidence.

risks.risk: The tool may not heat properly (no/weak temperature, faulty heating element), which directly affects usability.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the tip heating up (e.g., glowing/temperature behavior) after switching on, plus a quick functional test (melting solder or heating a small metal piece).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified for heating performance (worst case: may be defective or unreliable).

risks.risk: Tip condition may be worn/corroded or bent, reducing performance and requiring replacement.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the front metal tip(s) showing straightness, surface condition, and any markings; include whether spare tips are included.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tip wear/corrosion risk (worst case: tip may need replacement).

risks.risk: Cord/plug integrity may be compromised (cuts, loose connector, intermittent power).
risks.proof: End-to-end cord inspection shot and a clip showing stable power connection while operating (no flicker/sparking).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible cord/connector issues (worst case: intermittent power).

risks.risk: Wrong voltage/plug compatibility for Nigeria could prevent safe operation.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tool’s rating label (voltage/wattage) and plug type.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming compatibility uncertainty (worst case: requires adapter or may not run safely).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (stand, solder wire, desoldering pump, spare parts) reduce value.
risks.proof: A full contents photo laid out (everything included) and any accessory list shown by the seller.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tool-only with no accessories included.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating label (voltage/wattage) and plug type.
Send a short video: switch ON and show the tip reaching working temperature (or melting solder) within seconds.
Send close-up photos of the tip(s) showing wear/corrosion/straightness.
Send an end-to-end cord and connector close-up (no cuts/loose parts).
Show all included accessories in one laid-out photo (stand, solder wire, spare tips, etc.).
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an electric soldering/heat tool, but the seller’s key claims about an air pump and “tested and working” are not supported by the photos. A worst-case price still depends on whether it actually heats and the tip/cord condition, which are not verifiable from the current report.
